notes.title: Version 1.2.2 Released
notes.content:
Version 1.2.2 makes for another maintenance update. We fixed a few more small bugs and made some stability changes that should improve the mobile experience. But of course we had to toss in a few new gems and an oddity just for fun :)



 Three new gems can be crafted: Uranium, Platinum, Copper.
 Seven new legendary/mythic gems will now drop in the Primal Lands.
 New oddity available: Treasure Trasher.
 Fixed some small bugs and reduced memory usage to improve crash rates.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35779860/cbd0271a0edf191dcce32dc7c6d973b229d907ee.png

Before I go I wanted to drop a quick plug for a new project I'm working on called Signy and Mino; It's a fighting game RPG! It's... much different than Soda Dungeon, but Soda Dungeon isn't going anywhere either. If you'd like to see an extended writeup about this, please see this thread on reddit:
https://www.reddit.com/r/sodadungeon/comments/vnoysr/the_future_of_soda_dungeon_and_my_new_game/

Signy and Mino doesn't have a Steam page yet, but feel free to check out some screens and progress over at https://twitter.com/SignyAndMino

notes.title: Version 1.2.1 Released
notes.content:
Version 1.2.1 is what I like to call a "maintenance" update that addresses a lot of small requests, bugs, and balance changes. We hope everyone has enjoyed discovering new mythics in the Primal Lands; we still have more content in the pipeline so stick around!



 Reduced the max scroll speed of the town and purchase menus 
 Added protection against relic level overflow
 Added "max relic level" option for late-game players (credit to caviyacht)
 Ore will no longer be considered for script checks involving MP and will also be ignored for the "has no essence" trigger
 “Remove Enemy Death Animations” now also applies to ore veins
 Blacksmith’s “Lure” will now only proc after he is targeted by an enemy
 Can now script friendly skills when targeting enemies (defaults to weakest team member)
 Enigmatic Fragment drop chance increased from 1/100 to 1/90
 Soda Stein proc rate lowered from 13% to 12%
 Decreased the spawn rate of mammoth shield from 1/150 to 1/300
 Added missing enemy skill names: Feather Shot, Bolt, Black Slash
 Magnificent Robe base Magic Boost increased from 15% to 20%
 Keybringer key find chance reduced from 20% to 15%
 Internal Max Key Find Percent increased from 70% to 90%
 Key Find will now be shown capped at 90% when viewed in the party stats screen
 Judgement will now always succeed but has been given a cooldown of 1
 Group Cleanse cooldown reduced from 5 to 3
 Fish can no longer be caught inside of mineshafts
 Fixed an issue where expired status effects could still persist until the end of a turn
 Fixed an issue where the “Theme Preview” button wouldn’t disappear after purchasing a tavern theme bundle
 Adventure Log will now indicate when a dungeon party is defeated by “Surrender”
 Adventure Log will now indicate when a character dies from reflect damage
 Key HP/MP settings can now be specified in 5% increments
 Dropped enemy item bags will now reflect the rarity color of the item earned
 Optimized some loading/unloading of dungeon BG assets

notes.title: Dungeon 2, The Primal Lands, is now available!
notes.content:
Version 1.2, aka the Primal Lands, is a major expansion to Soda Dungeon 2!
You may access this area as long as you are in Dimension 2 or higher by speaking with the new character outside of the Wizard's Hut.



 5 new areas with new enemies, bosses, and attacks: The Tar Swamp, River, Veldt, Mountain, and Jungle.
 New story content and quests.
 50 new items, including MYTHICS!
 7 new minable ores and related plating effects.
 New stats to tinker with: Essence Multiplier, Withering (reduces enemy stats), +Battle credits per boss defeated, and Enemy stat boost (stronger enemies drop more gold)
 New statuses: MP Drain, Frozen, and Delirium (chance to attack friendly characters)
 Fixed an issue where the Drinkin' Buddies bundle wouldn't give characters back after entering a new dimension


This update has been in development for quite some time, so we hope the wait was worth it. Thank you to all of the Discord beta testers that helped to work the bugs out of the final build! For those interested in the nitty gritty details, here's a full list of patch notes for this update:


Wither currently caps at 90%
Fishing currently offers a 50/50 chance of boosting your team ATK or HP for the remainder of the run. Each battle location can only be fished once (if the battle takes place in the tar swamp or river)
New ores can naturally spawn in the veldt OR mountain, as well as the usual mineshafts
Of the 50 new items, 10 are rares, 2 per area, for lower level players
Of the 50, 23 are mythics. Of those 23, 13 are unique and can only be found once.
Mythics won’t drop until floor 1k and can't be obtained while using Battle Credits
Ambushes cannot occur in river/tar swamp
Paths in dungeon 2 will require 2 keys after level 1000 
Up to 2 ambushes per area can occur after level 1000 
In Dungeon 1 (Castle), enemy stat boosts received a 1.2x multiplier at level 500. Dungeon 2 has the same but bumps this to 1.3x at level 1k. Then, this multiplier grows by .1 every 10,000 levels. Note that this boost is added AFTER the base atk and hp are calculated
25% chance to encounter a seven enemy “swarm” on level x8 of the tar swamp and river

notes.title: Version 1.1.1 Released, Work on Dungeon 2 Continues
notes.content:
Version 1.1.1 is just a lil' update to pass along to everyone while we continue to work on Dungeon 2. Check out a new Dungeon 2 teaser below, and stay tuned!



 Added the Tavern Owner as a playable character along with his trusty SODA STEIN recipe, offering a chance for free relic levels on hit!
 Added Oddity: Defense Totem. Team starts their adventure in the "defend" state
 The Recruiter will now save your preferred pet + scripts with team loadouts
 Recruiter loadout names will be preserved when deleting and saving a new party in-place
 When dismantling plated items, spare resources will be discarded after reaching the 9999 limit (no warning given)
 You may now choose the number of Battle Credits to spend at each Quick Battle interval (up to 100,000)
 Quick Battle simulations now run twice as fast
 The Adventure Log can now be viewed while running a Quick Battle simulation
 Battle Credits earned during boss rush will now be shown on the Adventure Progress screen
 Anniversary town theme will now be preserved when resetting a save file OR re-applying the anniversary bundle
 Reduced the wait time for the final boss transformation in boss rush
 Uncapped the Essence Find relic. Every 50 points of essence find after your first 100 will add +1 essence each time essence is earned from an enemy

notes.title: Version 1.1 Released
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is our biggest update yet with the inclusion of the Adventure Guild, the Blacksmith as a playable character, Boss Rush mode in the Arena, and a ton of quality-of-life improvements!



 Added the Adventure Guild which provides new cosmetics, crafting recipes, and more for reaching certain level-based milestones (available in dimension 3)
 Added the Blacksmith as a playable character, offering enhanced damage reduction+reflection skills
 Added Oddity: Path Optimizer. speeds up path select/skip animation
 Added Ability to customize building exteriors (available after blacksmith has been built)
 Added "Boss Rush" to the arena after completing dimension 10
 Added a "craft all" button for resources
 Added two additional game file slots
 Changed Uranium Plating bonus from +crit chance to +% boost to ALL stats
 Increased Copper Plating bonus from 3% to 5% resist
 Removed the storage limit on battle credits (but can only earn 24 hours worth at one time)
 Added a method to recover local backup files from the file management menu
 Added ability to set customized loadout names at the recruiter
 Added a button to the party screen to toggle relic stats on/off
 Improved the readability of item info panels when they show a crafting recipe
 Now easier to see at a glance which items are chef ingredients in the compendium
 Reflect damage now capped by the maximum hp of the enemy being hit
 Reflected Damage values are now shown on screen
 Fixed: The screen can never sleep if the game prompts the player to revive their team during a run
 Added number highlighting to stat readouts
 Added page wrapping to the Adventure Results screen
 Reduced Eviscerate MP cost from 10 to 6

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 Released
notes.content:
Added The Item Plating System
 Added the Wizard as a playable character
 Added oddity: no boss death animations
 Added oddity: unlock SD1 tavern theme
 Added option: "autocombat always starts on"
 Added option: Allow screen to sleep after a run ends (MOBILE ONLY)
 Added the Cask upgrade to increase free refill rewards (MOBILE ONLY)
 Added +1000 relic level up
 Game window will now flash when a run ends (WINDOWS ONLY)
 Added a vsync toggle to desktop targets (240 fps cap)
 Added +2 to the max level of the status resist relic (allowing an even 13%)
 Battle Credit runs will now properly factor in your key/path settings 
 If the Blademaster kills an enemy with Double Strike while wielding two essence reavers, the essence bonus will now stack
 Fixed issue where X's default attack lost its unique animation (regression)
 Fixed issue where Blademaster primary/secondary weapon calcs were partially switched

notes.title: Version 1.0.8 Released
notes.content:
note: we bumped the version number due to an internal conflict, there is no version 1.0.7


 Added the Adventure Log upgrade. Use it to see what level your party members were defeated at, and why
 Added Korean game text
 Added the "Vacation" skin for the Dark Lord
 Added the Slow Stone as a crafting recipe available after level 1500. Use it to force fast characters into a normal turn progression
 When running a team with Item Find >= 100, it will now only be applied toward Legendary item rolls
 Every 15 points of ore find will now result in a +1% chance to "bump" the quality of mineshaft ore to the next level. Currently excludes naturally spawning ore and transmuted ore.
 The prospector skill has been reduced from +15 to +12 ore find. The geode has been reduced from +10 to +8 ore find
 The Essence Reaver will now give +15% essence when defeating an enemy holding essence
 Raised the position of status indicators in battle so that status effects for the 6th party member are no longer hidden
 Fixed an issue where the game can't exit when chef is the only remaining party because he will continue to attack by himself
 The Miner will now only attempt to transmute valid targets when autocombat is on
 Fixed an issue where the Huntress did not negate cooldown for the Blademaster's Stun skill
 Fixed an issue where the "Ore Blocker" oddity didn't remove ore from level 7
 Added a "no essence" trigger to compliment "has essence" trigger
 Chef's speed reduced from 151 to 150 to allow the player to decide which fast character they want to go first

notes.title: Version 1.0.6 Released
notes.content:
Added the Recruiter, who can hire entire teams with one click
 Added the Chef as a new character class. Use him to cook spare resources into buffs for your team during battle!
 Added the Wizard's "Oddity Shop," available in the Warrior's Dimension. He offers expensive upgrades to help optimize and speed up your gameplay, including free warps!
 Added a Spanish language translation
 Item Compendium will now show how many of each item you own
 Added the ability to copy an existing Soda Script
 Added a 10k warp increment (once reaching level 20k)
 Increased the chance of finding rare ores above level 5,000
 Increased the spawn rate of Red Smithing Crystals, and the Blacksmith will sometimes stock them in his inventory
 Added a crafting recipe for the "Dark Amulet" that appears in Dimension 5
 The game will now always ask you to confirm when attempting to spend caps on any purchase
 The Blademaster will no longer lose a turn for the Double Strike skill, instead the skill itself will require 1 turn of cooldown
 The Huntress' "Leader" skill will reduce cooldowns for any character on your team by 1
 The Huntress' bonus damage limit has increased from 500 to 1000, and the bonus per capture has increased from .2 to 1
 Reduced the Ossein Armor's Damage Reduction, Gave Damage Reduction to the Platinum Armor
 Fixed: Adventure Progress timer will no longer "reset" when reaching 24 hours
 Fixed: The Defend skill can now be used in Soda Scripts for defensive conditions
 Fixed: Ransack will no longer attempt to steal from the same enemy multiple times when used in Soda Scripts
 Fixed: Items in the Sell/Level Item menus will be sorted by ascending level instead of random
 Fixed: The Carpenter's "Sharpen" skill is now considered a positive status effect



For more information on The Chef, see here
For more information on the Recruiter, see here
For more information on the Oddity Shop, see here

notes.content:
Added customization options for the final class
 Added separate control for liquidating gems
 Added Level +5/10/25/100 to the relic screen

 Added a warp increment of 1000

 Pearl Gem buffed to give +10% attack boost and +10% hp boost
 Meat can now be dropped by the Crock Pot and Glazed Guardian enemies
 Fixed an issue where an empty soda script would crash the game
 Fixed an issue that caused town buildings to become un-clickable
 Fixed: Flash effects no longer show for bosses/fairies when turned off
 Fixed: Rounding error when displaying some relics with fractional bonuses
 Fixed: Using a team revive will now correctly re-apply your kitchen hp bonus
 Fixed: "Mark" skill will no longer increase enemy healing output
 Fixed: Blademaster will now correctly show offhand weapon stats such as evasion
 Fixed: Items that prevent status effects will now work against bad fairies
 Fixed: banner ads can no longer appear in the arena
 Fixed an issue where item sprites featuring armor would have oversized hitboxes
 Fixed some Russian and Chinese localization errors
 Fixed: Receiving essence as a gift in the mail will now update the HUD as expected
 Fixed a bug in the compendium that would display item MP as ATK
 The Tavern stairs no longer trigger a refresh prompt
 "Run In Background" is now enabled by default for desktop targets
 Red Crystal base drop rate increased from 1/50 to 1/40
 Blacksmith's inventory will now clear when moving to a new dimension
 Made the description of the 'Tap Select' upgrade more helpful
 Made the process of assigning a script more obvious
 Players can now copy their device id to the clipboard for support purposes

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Released
notes.content:
Item Find no longer applies to finding common/uncommon items, only rare and legendary
 Obsidian + Sulfur can now drop in all areas of the dungeon (previously only found in the Caverns). The actual drop rate is unchanged
 Fixed a visual issue where the pillars in the caverns could be drawn on top of some enemy+character sprites
 When entering a new dimension the warp level increment will always reset to 10 instead of getting stuck at 100
 Fixed an issue where the ruby would not be sent to users who need it to complete a Blacksmith quest
 Adjusted the functionality of the town buildings to (hopefully) fix some issues where buildings became "unclickable"

notes.title: Changing The Formula
notes.content:
As we've touched on before, our goal has always been to maintain the feel of what made Soda Dungeon 1 enjoyable while adding to it and improving on it in any way possible. AKA "If it ain't broke, don't fix it."

While this has been a guiding principle of ours, it also doesn't mean we wanted to copy Soda Dungeon 1 verbatim. We've talked before about brand new features and mechanics for the game like crafting, quests, and custom battle commands (Soda Script). But I also wanted to cover some of the smaller changes we've made to the mechanics moving forward into part 2.

You can hire six team members
There was always room for six, why not let players make use of it?


There is now a separate "Status Resist" stat
In SD1 you either had protection from status effects, or you didn't. Now there is a percentage chance depending what class you're using and what items you have equipped. We still have unique items to outright prevent certain effects on your character, but you can no longer "prevent all negative effects" like you could in SD1.


There is now a "Speed" stat
Some enemies can slow down your team's turn order, and some also have natural speed boosts that let them attack before you (or even twice in a row!). We tried not to get carried away here, because manipulation of the speed stat can result in wildly different outcomes at different dungeon levels.


There are no more "one use per battle" items
In SD1 special items (such as the heal stone) could be used once per battle, per character. This didn't seem incredibly intuitive, so now all abilities that your character has (whether granted innately or by an item) consume MP and can be used as long as MP remains. As an exception there are a couple of abilities that "exhaust" your character (instead of consuming MP) so the "cost" is that character losing their next turn.


Alternate "paths" have been replaced with portals and keys
SD1 would occasionally spawn paths that gave you a 50/50 shot of something good or bad. In SD2 they are now a set of three portals: One bad and two good, but one of the good ones is locked and tells you what is behind it. As you go through the dungeon there is a chance that minibosses and bosses will drop keys that can be used to unlock these portals.


Ambushes and "bad portals" can't be prevented (yet)
In SD1, the Knight prevented ambushes and bad paths. In SD2, the Huntress class can reduce their frequency but not completely prevent them. We tried to move away from "one size fits all" team compositions. This can also have a big impact on endgame, so we'll monitor the effect it has and see if we need to tweak it.


More ways to equip your character
Just to mix it up we tried out some new equipping mechanics: One class can equip two weapons but no shield, and another class can equip three items but no armor.


The Blacksmith now carries a dynamic inventory
In SD1 the Blacksmith always had a fixed set of items available to purchase. Now, after each run, he will feature an additional set of items that could have been found around the level you last ended at. There's even a small chance he could stock something rare, but it will cost a lot!


No more "Tavern Reputation"
One source of confusion from the original game was the "Tavern Reputation" stat. You could purchase a certain soda to attract a new class to the tavern, but it was possible they still wouldn't show up if you didn't have a high enough reputation. This didn't really seem to enhance the gameplay experience so we made it simple: If you buy a soda for a certain class, that class can now spawn. And instead of requiring you to purchase "decor" upgrades to boost your reputation, you can now just purchase individual cosmetics (new stools, tables, floor, etc) to customize the tavern to your liking.


Characters now have "Masteries"
Characters now accumulate XP while fighting in the dungeon, which translates into "Mastery" levels. Each level grants a small bonus, like +2 hp or +1 atk. Level 25 gives each character a new skill, and Level 50 gives each character a special "class relic" that you can use to boost their stats. We plan to expand mastery levels and bonuses in the future.



... and I think that covers it! There's probably a few extra things I could tack on but this already ended up longer than expected. Besides, some things have to be a surprise, right? Before I finish up I wanted to mention one last important thing: Soda Dungeon 2 Comes To Android Early Access In Late May! We're looking to consolidate our testing and feedback onto one platform during this final phase, which will benefit all platforms when we launch in full. For more information, please see our post on reddit. More big updates are coming down the pipeline soon!
